verdict.rationale: Drata has a trust center (SafeBase branding and URL setup, an analytics dashboard) that can be managed programmatically via the API. It also continuously monitors controls through monitoring tests. Nothing shows the trust center syncing itself, though: keeping it current appears to depend on building your own API automation. Missing for 10: documented automatic sync of control status to the trust center, automatic subprocessor list updates, automated document renewal/expiry handling, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
